description: Quadtree (2D) and octree (3D) spatial partitioning for hierarchical force computation, enabling O(N log N) gravity
mathematical_formalization: Quadtree: recursively partition [x_min,x_max]x[y_min,y_max] into 4 children; node stores center of mass M_node = sum(m_i), R_node = sum(m_i*r_i)/M_node
analogical_connections: k-d trees in ML nearest neighbor
implementation_hypothesis: QuadTreeNode class with insert/subdivide methods; recursive force walk with theta criterion s/d < theta
experiment_seed: Verify tree depth scales as O(log N) for uniform random distributions; measure tree construction time
